A1.justification: Both complete 28-page PDFs describe ViFailback and include matching 18-page supplements. The text, tables, figures, and appendix material support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, training-data scaling experiments, and real-world robot success rates, with qualitative examples in the appendix.

after.justification: v3 retains these original benchmark, scaling, and robotic manipulation results, including the appendix examples.

M1.justification: The visual-symbol annotation pipeline, Qwen3-VL-8B finetuning, and VSF/PMC recovery procedures are retained. Appendix prompt corrections resolve inconsistencies in the documented procedure without establishing a changed algorithm or architecture.

E1.justification: Both versions retain 100 manipulation tasks, the 22-task benchmark, and three real-world evaluation tasks. Appendix Figure 2 repairs task 16's description to match its existing pick_cube_place_plate identifier; its identity and trajectory allocation remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 retain the same 16 comparator models across the Qwen, InternVL, RoboBrain, Cosmos, GPT-4o, and Gemini families. Table 4 retains the same policy baselines and VSF/PMC comparisons.

E3.justification: The reported training count changes from 52,416 to 52,418 VQA pairs, and the total from 58,126 to 58,128. Trajectory splits, metrics, training budgets, and robot-trial design remain unchanged. These are reported sample-count revisions; the PDFs do not establish experimental reruns.

E4.justification: The training-data scaling analysis in Figure 4, symbol-data control comparison in Table 4, and appendix case studies in Figures 12–22 are retained. No ablation, robustness test, or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version adds seeds, repeated-training-run information, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests. Both retain 21 robot trials per task and the same success-count reporting.

E6.justification: Table 2 changes Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct's Lite average from 36.56 to 38.33, matching Table 1. Section 4.3 corrects the VSF gain from 21.4% to 20.6%, consistent with unchanged Table 4 rates of 52.4% and 73.0%. Figure 2 changes total trajectory duration from 860.84 to 864.76 minutes. Other performance results and qualitative findings are retained.

T1.justification: Task and failure-category definitions, spatial conventions, and visual-symbol semantics remain unchanged. Neither version contains a theoretical contribution with theorems or proofs, and no new mathematical reasoning is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: efficient visual-symbol annotation, a failure diagnosis/correction benchmark, improved VLM performance, and assistance with real-world failure recovery. Small numerical corrections do not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: The interpretations of data scaling, difficulties with multistep guidance, and PMC versus VSF performance are retained. Section 5 keeps the same discussion of visual supervision and future use of failure-trajectory action distributions.

D1.justification: Appendix Figures 5 and 7–9 correct the avoidance keyframe description, mislabeled correction commands, success-status option counts, and template formatting. The task 16 description is also repaired. Hardware, LoRA settings, camera masking, inference timing, and the project website link remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2.1 adds a sentence about efficient data collection through hardware and shared control, citing Human-agent joint learning for efficient robot manipulation skill acquisition and exumi (v3 references 28 and 39). The broader research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Scattered grammar, spelling, terminology, and heading corrections appear throughout both the main text and appendix. Author correspondence information and acknowledgements are expanded, while the narrative and section order are retained.

P2.justification: Main figures are resized or locally reformatted, including refreshed artwork in Figures 2–3. Tables 2–3 gain explanations of existing bold/underline conventions, and appendix Figure 11 corrects a wrist-view label. No figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v3 resolves the Qwen3-VL-8B cross-table mismatch and the VSF gain arithmetic, while appendix prompts more consistently distinguish avoidance from correction. These targeted fixes improve reporting accuracy and reproducibility. The central methods, experimental evidence, and conclusions remain stable, so the overall improvement is limited.
